prompt.label: What have you been working on?
prompt.placeholder: e.g. 2 hours on the website for Jensen yesterday
prompt.hintAvailable: Type or dictate, then press Enter. Speech is processed locally in your browser and the audio is not sent anywhere.
prompt.install: Download speech recognition (about 60 MB, runs locally)
prompt.hintDefault: Type and press Enter, e.g. “1.5 h meeting with Acme at 9-10:30”. On a phone you can dictate with the microphone on the keyboard. Press <kbd>/</kbd> to jump here.
prompt.missingHint: pick a suggestion below, or fix it in the full form.
prompt.descriptionPlaceholder: What was the time spent on?
prompt.needDescription: Write a short description before you save.
prompt.savedOffline: Saved offline. The time entry will be sent when the connection is back.
prompt.saveFailed: Could not save the time entry

welcome.title: Welcome to {brand}
welcome.titleDone: Off to a good start. Your first time entry is tracked
welcome.intro: Get started in under a minute: start a timer now, or type what you have been working on in the field below, e.g. “2 hours on the website yesterday”. You can sort out company details and plan later.
welcome.timerStarted: The timer is running. Stop it in the timer bar at the top when you are done.
welcome.writeLine: Type a line in the field
welcome.surveyQuestion: What will you mainly use {brand} for? <muted>(optional)</muted>
welcome.saveFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Try again.
welcome.thanksNote: Thanks. Home now shows the next steps that fit you.
welcome.privacyNote: The answer is only used to tailor Home and is not shared with anyone else.

quickStart.title: Start timer
quickStart.running: The timer is already running. Stop it in the timer bar at the top before you start a new one.
quickStart.paused: The timer is paused. Resume or save it in the timer bar at the top first.
quickStart.resumeToast: The timer has started and continues the latest entry
quickStart.empty: Your most used projects will show up here once you have tracked some time.
